title: Some Variation
description: This makes some mobs have some variation, hence the name.
body:
This resource pack adds some variation to some mobs.  

Creeper-  
   Adds a variant that has TNT sticking out of it.  
   Changes creepers legs to be further apart.  
Skeleton-  
     Have a chance to have a quiver on their back.  
Cow-  
     Adds 2 variants, the dairy cow(based off of the More Mob Variants Mod) and the highland cow.  
Chicken-  
     Adds 2 variants, the brown chicken, and the grey chicken.  
Ghast-  
     Changes its texture to have a lot more fire.
